'''Bielszowickism''' is a source-listed branch of [[Taoism]].

No dedicated Bielszowickism source page has been found in the current checkout. The name resembles later Mariposian material associated with Bielszowicki, but the current 1994-back pass does not treat that as proof of a pre-1994 ideology.

== Canon Limits ==

Do not assign Bielszowickism a founder, doctrine, party, state, revolution, or pre-1994 adoption until stronger source material is reviewed.
